description_en: Queries a list of instances. You can also specify filter conditions to query specific instances
description_zh: 分页获取任务实例列表，也可以通过条件进行筛选查询
name: ListTaskInstances

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 项目ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The data timestamp. The value of this parameter is 00:00:00 of the day before the scheduling time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds. Example: 1743350400000
parameters.help_zh: 业务日期。一般是周期实例定时时间的前一天的0点0分0秒，格式为毫秒级时间戳，如1743350400000
parameters.name: bizdate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task for which the instance is generated
parameters.help_zh: 对应任务的ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the tasks. You can query multiple instances at a time by task ID
parameters.help_zh: 对应任务的ID列表，可根据任务Id批量查询任务实例
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the task. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 对应任务的名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the task owner
parameters.help_zh: 任务的责任人的账号ID
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The type of the task for which the instance is generated
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型。各节点的TaskType取值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the resource group. Set this parameter to the identifier of a resource group for scheduling
parameters.help_zh: 资源组信息，这里请填入调度资源组标识符
parameters.name: runtime_resource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow to which the instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 所属工作流的ID
parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.help_en: The unified workflow instance ID. For all task instances under a specific data timestamp within a single trigger, this field has the same value
parameters.help_zh: 统一工作流实例Id，某次触发下某业务日期内的所有任务实例的该字段值相等
parameters.name: unified_workflow_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the workflow instance. Valid values:

SmokeTest: Testing

Manual: Manually triggered node

SupplementData: Data backfill

ManualWorkflow: Manually triggered workflow

Normal: Scheduled execution

TriggerWorkflow: Triggered Workflow
parameters.help_zh:
所属工作流实例的类型。
SmokeTest：测试
Manual：手动任务
SupplementData：补数据
ManualWorkflow：手动工作流
Normal：周期调度
TriggerWorkflow：触发式工作流
parameters.name: workflow_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The workflow instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 所属工作流实例的ID
parameters.name: workflow_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values:

Prod: production environment

Dev: development environment
parameters.help_zh:
项目环境。
Prod：生产
Dev：开发
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. The instance may be rerun. If the instance is rerun and you configure this parameter, the system returns the historical information of the instance, including the rerun information. You can use the RunNumber parameter to distinguish each entry in the historical information
parameters.help_zh: 任务实例ID。任务实例存在重跑的情况，假如设置该参数，则返回包含重跑的历史信息，通过RunNumber区分每个历史信息
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances. You can query multiple instances at a time by instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务实例ID列表，可根据任务实例Id批量查询多个任务实例信息
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type. Valid values:

Scheduler: scheduling cycle-based trigger

Manual: manual trigger
parameters.help_zh:
触发方式类型。
Scheduler：周期调度触发
Manual：手动触发
parameters.name: trigger_type

parameters.help_en:
The running mode of the instance after it is triggered. This parameter takes effect only if the TriggerType parameter is set to Scheduler. Valid values:

Pause

Skip

Normal
parameters.help_zh:
触发时的运行模式，TriggerType=Scheduler时生效。
Pause：暂停
Skip：空跑
Normal：正常运行
parameters.name: trigger_recurrence

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Fields such as TriggerTime and StartedTime are supported. The value of this parameter is in the Sort field + Sort by (Desc/Asc) format. By default, results are sorted in ascending order. Valid values:

`TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)`

`StartedTime (Desc/Asc)`

`FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)`

`CreateTime (Desc/Asc)`

`Id (Desc/Asc)`

  Default value: `Id Desc`
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。支持定时时间、开始时间等字段，格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：

`TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)`

`StartedTime (Desc/Asc)`

`FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)`

`CreateTime (Desc/Asc)`

`Id (Desc/Asc)`

  默认值：`Id Desc`
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页的条目数，默认为10，最大为500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从1开始，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The status of the task instance.

`NotRun`: Not started

`Running`

`Failure`

`Success`

`WaitTime`: Awaiting scheduled time

`WaitResource`: Awaiting resources
parameters.help_zh:
任务实例的状态：
`NotRun`：未运行
`Running`：运行中
`Failure`：运行失败
`Success`：运行成功
`WaitTime`：等待时间
`WaitResource`：等待资源
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The filter. It is in JSON format, and multiple filter conditions are combined with a logical AND. Currently supported fields include: `startedTimeStart`, `startedTimeEnd`, `finishedTimeStart`, `finishedTimeEnd`, `createTimeStart`, `createTimeEnd`
parameters.help_zh: 过滤器。JSON格式，多个过滤条件之间是"且"的关系。目前支持的字段有：`startedTimeStart, startedTimeEnd, finishedTimeStart, finishedTimeEnd, createTimeStart, createTimeEnd`
parameters.name: filter

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

CreateUser.description_en: The account ID of the user who creates the instance

DataSource.description_en: The information about the associated data source

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

FinishedTime.description_en: The time when the instance finished running

Id.description_zh: 任务实例的唯一标识符

ModifyUser.description_en: The account ID of the user who modifies the instance

Owner.description_en: The account ID of the task owner

PeriodNumber.description_en: The sequence number of the cycle. This parameter indicates the cycle of the task instance on the current day
PeriodNumber.description_zh: 周期序号。表示任务实例处于当天的第几轮周期

Priority.description_en: The priority of the task. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 8. A larger value indicates a higher priority. Default value: 1
Priority.description_zh: 任务运行优先级，最小值1，最大值8。取值越大，优先级越高。默认优先级为1

ProjectEnv.description_en:
The environment of the workspace.

Valid values:

Prod: production environment

Dev: development environment
ProjectEnv.description_zh:
项目环境。
Prod：生产
Dev：开发

RerunMode.description_en:
The rerun mode

Valid values:

AllDenied: The task cannot be rerun regardless of whether the task is successfully run or fails to run.

FailureAllowed: The task can be rerun only after it fails to run.

AllAllowed: The task can be rerun regardless of whether the task is successfully run or fails to run
RerunMode.description_zh:
任务是否允许重跑的配置。
AllDenied：失败或成功都不可重跑
FailureAllowed：只有失败可重跑
AllAllowed：失败或成功均可重跑
RerunMode.title_en: 任务是否允许重跑的配置
RerunMode.title_zh: 任务是否允许重跑的配置

RunNumber.description_en: The number of times the task is run. By default, the value starts from 1
RunNumber.description_zh: 当前运行的次数，默认从1开始

Runtime.description_en: The runtime information about the instance

RuntimeResource.description_en: The information about the resource group with which the instance is associated

Cu.description_en: The default number of CUs configured for task running

Image.description_en: The ID of the image configured for task running

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group for scheduling configured for task running
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 任务运行配置的调度资源组标识符

StartedTime.description_en: The time when the instance started to run
StartedTime.description_zh:
开始运行时间。

格式为 13 位数字，例如 `1710239005403`

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance.

Valid values:

NotRun: The instance is not run.

Running: The instance is running.

WaitTime: The instance is waiting for the scheduling time to arrive.

CheckingCondition: Branch conditions are being checked for the instance.

WaitResource: The instance is waiting for resources.

Failure: The instance fails to be run.

Success: The instance is successfully run.

Checking: Data quality is being checked for the instance
Status.description_zh:
实例运行状态。
NotRun：未运行
Running：运行中
WaitTime：等待TriggerTime到来
CheckingCondition：分支条件检验
WaitResource：等待资源
Failure：执行失败
Success：执行成功
Checking：下发给数据质量校检
WaitTrigger（等待外部触发，触发式节点会在等待时间后变成等待触发）
